name: MD-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Mfume running with financial edge
No competitive polling or expert ratings
model.rationale: Mfume holds a heavily Democratic Baltimore-area seat with a large cash advantage over a little-known, underfunded Republican challenger, and prediction markets price a Democratic win near certain. Fundamentals point to a margin around 30 points, consistent with Safe D.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing a much closer race or unexpected incumbent vulnerability would warrant a shift.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Kweisi Mfume, a well-known Democratic incumbent, seeks another term in a Baltimore-based district that voted roughly 31 points more Democratic than the nation in recent elections. He has built a solid war chest of about $700,000, while Republican Scott Collier reports minimal fundraising and little outside support. No public polls or expert ratings track this race, but prediction markets give Mfume about a 96% chance of winning.

The forecast rests on the district's strong Democratic lean, incumbency, and the lopsided money situation. A margin near 30 points with modest uncertainty fits the evidence, keeping the seat firmly in the Safe D category.
